sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:46479
Court No. - 76
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 36476 of 2023

Applicant :- Majid
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Kamal Kishor Mishra,Sharad Rastogi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
On 21.08.2023 notice was issued to the informant of the case.
As per the office report dated 16.09.2023, notice has already been served upon the informant.
Despite service of notice, none appeared on behalf of the informant.

2. Heard Sri Kamal Kishor Mishra, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri R.N. Srivastava,
learned AGA for the State-respondent.
3.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
62 of 2022, under Sections 363, 376 IPC & 3/4 POCSO Act & 3(2)(Va) SC/ST Act, Police Station- Babugarh, District- Hapur, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that this is the second bail application filed on behalf of the applicant and his first bail application was dismissed on merit by this Court on 20.04.2023 and he is pressing the instant second bail application on the ground that applicant is in jail since 25.02.2022 i.e. for last more than two years and till date, trial could not be concluded and, therefore,
Majid vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 14 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/96413879/
1 considering the delay in trial and long incarceration of the applicant of more than two years, he should be enlarged on bail.
5.

entities.text: Majid vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that allegations against the applicant are quite serious and as per allegation, he committed rape upon 14 years' old girl and after considering the entire facts of the case, his first bail application was dismissed on merit by this Court, therefore, merely on the ground that applicant is in jail for last more than two years, his bail should not be allowed.
However, learned AGA suggested that that a specific direction may be given to the trial court to conclude the trial.
6. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

7. This is the second bail application filed on behalf of the applicant and his first bail application was dismissed on merit by this Court on 20.04.2023 and it appears that as per allegation, applicant committed rape upon 14 years' girl and, therefore, allegation against him are quite serious

, however,
applicant is in jail for last more than two years but considering the nature of allegation and age of the victim, I am not inclined to release the applicant on bail at this stage.
8.
Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant second bail application is dismissed.

9. However, considering the fact that applicant is in jail for more than two years, trial court is directed to conclude the trial of the case within a period of six months from the date of production of certified copy of this order, strictly as per the provisions of Sections 35 POCSO Act, 14 SC/ST Act and 309 Cr.P.C. on day-to-day basis without granting any unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties, if there is no legal impediment.

10. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.

Order Date :- 14.3.2024 KK Patel  Majid vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 14 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/96413879/
